lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense matrix of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot diameter is greatest in the mid-flank region, with a transition to smaller, more densely packed spots near the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, most clearly visible in the mid-lateral section where the blobs serve as high-intensity anchor nodes within a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper-third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and pronounced shadowing on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent pale, rectangular region with suppressed spot contrast is located immediately anterior to the first gill slit. Additionally, four artificial white arrow annotations are overlaid, pointing to the first branchial opening.
